10. One table with holder, role, old/new expiry and outcome/reason: verified by GrantExtensionReport::text.
11. Nonzero exit naming every refused grant: verified by grants_outcome.
12. Never shorten longer grants: verified by pre-lock and locked deadline comparisons.
13. Never revive expired/revoked grants: verified by target lifetime checks; concurrent ancestor invalidation is unverified (finding 3).
14. No relay double extension; skip replacements, predecessors and descendants: unverified for ancestor supersession during a descendant lock wait (finding 3); static regression exists.
